topic: Job interview roleplay: checking in at reception

script.title: Roleplay at reception: "I have an interview"

lines.text: Good morning! Are you here for an interview?
Hi, I'm Mia Chen. I have an interview with Ms. Park at ten.
Thanks, Ms. Chen. Please have a seat. She'll be out in a minute.
Kit's tip: say your name, who you're meeting, and the time. That's all reception needs.

script.caption: What to say at reception: "I have an interview"
